name: Analytics & Operations Dashboard
description: Extended frontend profile specialized for dashboards with data, filter, timezone, and role-based access control (RBAC) verification.

tools.name: node
tools.description: Node.js runtime inherited from frontend for build, typecheck, and testing.

tools.name: playwright
tools.description: Browser automation for verifying tables/charts, filters, timezone handling, and RBAC flows.

candidate_checks.description: Unit tests for data transformers, filter synchronization, timezone conversion (UTC/local), and RBAC.
Verify compilation and bundling of the dashboard interface according to the repository configuration.
Browser E2E tests for role-based display permissions (RBAC) and filter interactions.

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the repository-accepted data, filter, timezone, RBAC, and build checks
Valid file scope evidence and git diff --check verification
Evidence classification results from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and review from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Timezone mismatches (UTC vs local timezone) causing date shifts in charts or session reports
Filter state (filter/pagination/sort) becoming desynchronized or retaining stale data across page transitions
RBAC checks only hiding DOM elements while still fetching or exposing sensitive data in state or network responses
Displaying financial metrics (PnL/funding/risk) without activating the quant profile and --work-kind quant
quant_escalation_required_when: Any dashboard task involving PnL, funding, liquidation, margin, leverage, or risk metrics must explicitly select the quant profile and --work-kind quant
